messages:
Jordan Park: hi all, quick onboarding question — where should I keep my personal learning log vs the canonical team docs? also who do I ping for edit rights on the "onboarding checklist" template? @DocOps
Eli Ramos: welcome! Personal learning logs = your private workspace (My Pages). Canonical team docs live in Company Wiki > Docs Library > Teams > Eng > Onboarding. If you want others to see your log, move to Team > New Hires.
Nina Gomez: templates are in Company Wiki > Templates > Onboarding. Ownership is in the template header (Owner: Team Docs / person). If it shows "unowned" or still says "placeholder", tag the Docs team with a comment and we'll pick it up.
Jordan Park: is there a fast way to request edit rights? I don't want to hunt through forms during ramp week
Lena Wu: two options: quick Slack ping for small, urgent edits or the formal request for audit/history. Slack quick: @DocOps mention + page link. Formal (preferred): the docs-access form so we can audit changes and grant proper permissions. Example slack snippet:
```
@DocOps please grant edit -> https://notion.redwood.company/Company/Docs/Onboarding/Onboarding-Checklist --reason "need to customize for my role" --cc @Eli
```
That creates a ticket if you include the page link.
DocOps Bot: Ticket created: DOCS-7124 for Jordan Park -> Onboarding-Checklist. Assigned: Docs (Eng) queue. ETA: 24h.
Jordan Park: perfect, thanks — filed the slack request. last thing: any recommended 30/60/90 template I should use (eng-specific)?
Nina Gomez: yes, Templates > New Hire Toolkit > Eng 30-60-90. It has checkpoints mapped to our onboarding curriculum. Duplicate it to your workspace and rename (e.g., "Jordan Park - 30/60/90"). If you want your manager as an editor, add them and tag me and I'll verify permissions.
Eli Ramos: FYI if you fork a canonical page, add a small banner at top: "Derived from Company Template - do not edit source." keeps maintainers sane. :sunglasses:
Jordan Park: thanks everyone! saved me a bunch of time. will share the duplicated checklist in my manager 1:1. :wave:
